issues.description: The template's Main.java references a Farm method named feed() (commented usage), while the problem statement and the reference solution expect a method named feedAllAnimals() on Farm. Additionally, the template Farm.java does not provide a feedAllAnimals() implementation or a feed() alias. This name/signature mismatch between example usage in Main and the required Farm API can confuse students about which method to implement and may cause compilation errors if they follow the Main example.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the specification: update the example usage in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call feedAllAnimals(), and/or add a feed() delegating method in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java that calls feedAllAnimals(). Ensure the Farm API in the template matches the method name documented in the problem statement (feedAllAnimals()).

issues.description: The template Main.java calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the solution implement and document the method as feedAllAnimals(). This inconsistent method name for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals on the farm) can cause students to be unable to map the exercise requirements to the provided template code and will produce a compile error if they uncomment Main.java.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the call in the template Main.java from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or alternatively provide a delegating Farm.feed() method that calls feedAllAnimals(), so the template, problem statement, and solution consistently refer to the same method name.
